P: Ādāya，[ger. of ādāti，either from base 1 of dadāti （dā） or base 2 （dāy）. See also ādiya] having received or taken，taking up，seizing on，receiving； freq. used in the sense of a prep. “with” （c. Acc.） Sn.120，247，452； J.V，13； Vbh.245； DhA.II，74； SnA 139； PvA.10，13，38，61 etc. -- At Vin.I，70 the form ādāya is used as a noun f. ādāyā in meaning of “a casually taken up belief” （tassa ādāyassa vaṇṇe bhaṇati）. Cp. upa°，pari°. （Page 98）
